records.title: 10-K
records.text: The aggregate market value of the stock of the Registrant as of July 31, 2022 (based on a closing price of $98.45 per share) held by non-affiliates was approximately $14.9 billion.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We had over 7,000 integrations with cloud, mobile and web applications and IT infrastructure providers as of January 31, 2023, which while not directly correlated to revenue, shows the breadth and acceptance of our platform.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Organizations are able to streamline user experience and improve security across all their applications, leading to increased customer acquisition, retention and loyalty.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As of January 31, 2023, we had more than 17,600 customers, including more than 3,930 customers with an annual contract value greater than $100,000.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: From fiscal 2021 to fiscal 2022, our revenue grew from $835 million to $1,300 million, an increase of 56%, and from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023, our revenue grew from $1,300 million to $1,858 million, an increase of 43%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales are historically higher in the fourth fiscal quarter due primarily to the impact of the holiday selling season.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Showroom net sales increased $$99.5 million, or 33.3%, to $398.5 million in fiscal 2023 as compared to $299.0 million in fiscal 2022, principally related to higher point of sales transactions in all showrooms with slightly higher promotional discounting.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Other sales, which include pop-up-shop sales, barter inventory transactions and shop-in-shop sales, increased $27.9 million, or 57.4%, to $76.5 million in fiscal 2023 as compared to $48.6 million in fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our recent revenue growth has been accompanied by increased selling, general and administrative expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal 2023, net cash used in operating activities was $21.4 million and consisted of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $90.8 million, net income of $28.2 million, and non-cash items of $41.2 million.
